_doc: sglang serving template: 2-GPU tensor-parallel, for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and similar MoE/dense models on 2x H100. Mirrors vllm/tp2.json so swapping engines is a BACKEND override. Engine knobs consumed by backend/sglang/serve.sh via scripts/load_backend_env.py; each can be overridden with the matching env var (TP, PORT, GPU_MEM_UTIL, MAX_MODEL_LEN, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES).
